title: Meter widget: percentage inside the ring, label below, no collisions
changes: The meter label moved out of the dial and sits under it; the percentage is alone inside the inner ring, so text no longer touches the rings or the ticks
The dial (including the 2- and 3-ring index variants) is capped by screen height so the dial and its label always fit inside the hero card
Checked in all five tabs at five screen sizes, including values like 210 and 511 percent
